name: Strata
description: Starter data kits for decomposing headline effects in experimental, clinical-population, and omics analysis.

kits.title: NHANES 2017–2018: cardiometabolic exam, HbA1c, lipids, and glucose
kits.framing: Judge whether a cardiometabolic screening or fitness-benefit program's headline A1c / LDL / BMI change still holds after decomposing by age, sex, race/ethnicity, education, and income.
kits.source: CDC / NCHS National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017–2018
kits.license: U.S. Public Domain (17 U.S.C. 105) — work of the U.S. government

files.name: fact_exam.csv

files.name: dim_year.csv
